name: Web browser help
description: Help mode entries for the Web browser plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Web browser
entries.text: Opens any website in a pane inside the console. Amber, the API and the CLI can open pages here too; every page opened is logged.

entries.title: Address
entries.text: Type a web address (example.com or a full https link) and tap Go. Only http and https pages open.

entries.title: Go
entries.text: Opens the address in the pane below and adds it to the log.

entries.title: Reload
entries.text: Loads the page in the pane again.

entries.title: Open in a new tab
entries.text: Opens the page in a normal browser tab. Use it when the pane stays blank: many big sites refuse to be shown inside other pages.

entries.title: Close the page
entries.text: Clears the pane. The close is logged too.

entries.title: Recently opened
entries.text: The last pages opened here, from any source. Tap one to open it again.

entries.title: Web browser settings
entries.text: Install or uninstall the Web browser plugin. Uninstalling removes its log.

steps.say: Type an address and tap Go to open any website here.
Pages Amber opens for you show up here too, and every one is logged below.
